name: Kansas Eats: Restaurants
subtitle: Chicken & BBQ across Kansas
description:
Kansas's restaurants, from Crawford County fried chicken dinners to barbecue on the Kansas side of Kansas City and onion sliders in Salina.

Kansas Eats is a free guide to eating in Kansas: 6 Crawford County chicken dinner halls, 23 barbecue restaurants, 6 slider and drive-in stops and 4 heritage tables we checked by hand, plus 5,711 restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries in 374 towns, from Wichita, Overland Park and Kansas City to Topeka, Lawrence, Salina and Dodge City. No account, no ads.

KANSAS GUIDES
• Crawford County Fried Chicken: from Chicken Annie's Original (1934) and Chicken Mary's (1942) to Barto's Idle Hour in Frontenac.
• Kansas Barbecue: Joe's Kansas City Bar-B-Que on the Kansas side, Wichita's pits and small-town smokehouses.
• Sliders & Drive-Ins: the Cozy Inn (1922), NuWay's loose-meat burgers (1930) and Bobo's carhops.
• Heritage Tables: the Hays House 1857 on the Santa Fe Trail and Volga German cooking in Hays.
• James Beard Honors and Oldest Places.

FIND IT FAST
• Sort by distance, or browse the map by guide.
• Search by name, town, street or dish: "fried chicken", "burnt ends", "sliders".
• Filter by town or cuisine, or hide chains.
• Save places, and find hand-checked places from iPhone search (Spotlight).

LIVE DETAILS FROM APPLE MAPS
Tap "Ratings, hours & photos" on any place to open Apple Maps' own place card, with current hours, photos, ratings and directions.

HOW THE LISTS ARE BUILT
Every guide place was checked by hand in fall 2026 against a dated 2025 or 2026 source or a Kansas tourism office's own page. The rest come from Overture Maps open data, kept by the reliability rule tested in the states that publish official restaurant lists. The Kansas Department of Agriculture inspects restaurants with no official grade and publishes no results as data, so the app shows no inspection result and links KDA's inspection-results page. Website links are checked too. Nothing is ranked by star ratings, and the app computes no grades. Newer restaurant data downloads from the Kansas Eats website when there is some.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location, if you share it, only sorts lists on your device. Saved places stay on your device.

Places open and close, so check before you go. Spot a mistake? Email nick@eatsranked.com.

An independent app, not affiliated with any restaurant, chain or government agency (including the State of Kansas or the Kansas Department of Agriculture), any team or university, the Kansas Sampler Foundation or the James Beard Foundation. James Beard Foundation and James Beard Award are trademarks of the James Beard Foundation. Place data from Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA Permissive 2.0) and others; sources and licenses are on the About tab.

reviewNotes:
1. Purpose and audience: Kansas Eats is a free guide to restaurants in Kansas (the U.S. state). Its focus is the state's own food: Crawford County fried chicken, barbecue, sliders and drive-ins, and heritage tables, 39 places checked by hand in fall 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source, plus the James Beard Foundation's honorees. It also lists 5,711 restaurants, cafés and bars in 374 towns from open map data. It is for residents and visitors deciding where to eat, with no ads, account or tracking.

2. How to use it (no login, no setup, no sample files needed):
- Home → Crawford County Fried Chicken (or Kansas Barbecue, Sliders & Drive-Ins, Heritage Tables, James Beard Honors, Oldest Places, Near Me) → tap any place.
- On a place, tap "Ratings, hours & photos" to open Apple Maps' own place card through MapKit. Directions, Call and Website are below it; further down, a link opens the Kansas Department of Agriculture's inspection-results page in Safari (Kansas publishes no inspection results as data, so none is shown).
- Search from the Home search box by name, town, street or dish ("fried chicken", "burnt ends", "sliders").
- The Map tab shows each guide as pins. "My location" and the Nearest sort use location only if allowed, on the device.
- The heart saves a place on the device (Saved tab). The About tab lists the sources, licenses and the independence statement.
- On iPad, a sidebar replaces the tabs; a place opens in the right-hand column.
- Location: if you're outside Kansas (as App Review usually is), the map says so and stays on Kansas, and distance sorting still works from where you are.
- "Kansas Eats" is the Home Screen name of "Kansas Eats: Restaurants".

3. External services and data:
- Apple MapKit: maps, local search to find a place's Apple Maps listing, and Apple's place card for live hours, photos and ratings.
- Core Location: optional, on-device only, for distance sorting.
- Data updates: at most once a day, the app checks the Kansas Eats website (static files on GitHub Pages) for newer restaurant data and downloads it if there is some. The requests carry no identifiers or location.
- No backend, accounts, analytics, advertising, payments or AI services. The restaurant data is bundled in the app.
- Bundled data sources: Overture Maps Foundation open place data (CDLA Permissive 2.0 and others; license texts are in the app); James Beard Foundation honors (facts only); and our own research of public websites, local news and official tourism pages.
- The website with the privacy policy and support page is static and hosted on GitHub Pages: https://nickstrom5.github.io/kansas-eats/

4. Regional differences: none. The content covers Kansas; the app is offered in the United States and works the same everywhere.

5. Regulated or protected material: the app is not in a regulated industry and includes no protected third-party material. The data is open-licensed, with attribution and licenses on the About tab. Ratings, hours and photos are shown only inside Apple's own place card through MapKit; the app stores no ratings or reviews. The app shows no inspection results and computes no grades. Every website link was checked before release, and adult venues are excluded. The app is independent and not affiliated with any restaurant, agency or the James Beard Foundation.
